title: LINE settings
intro: Connect BCS to the LINE Official Account of your organization. Copy every value from LINE Developers Console, all from the same provider.

state.notConfigured: LINE is not set up. Members get their tasks and notifications by e-mail only.
state.active: LINE is on. Members who linked their account get tasks and notifications in LINE.
state.inactive: LINE is off. Members get their tasks and notifications by e-mail instead.

fields.messagingChannelId: Channel ID of the Messaging API channel
fields.liffChannelId: Channel ID of the LINE MINI App channel (LIFF)

hints.providerId: LINE Developers Console → Providers → Provider ID
hints.messagingChannelId: Messaging API channel → Basic settings → Channel ID (digits)
hints.liffId: LINE MINI App channel → LIFF ID, for example 1234567890-AbCdEfGh
hints.liffChannelId: LINE MINI App channel → Basic settings → Channel ID (digits)
hints.active: When off, nothing is sent by LINE (e-mail is used instead) and the BCS pages in the LINE app do not open.

secret.unreadable: The saved value cannot be read. Enter it again and save.
secret.keep: Leave empty to keep the saved value. It is encrypted and never shown again.
secret.first: Required the first time you save. It is encrypted and never shown again.
secret.channelSecretWhere: Messaging API channel → Basic settings → Channel secret
secret.channelAccessTokenWhere: Messaging API channel → Messaging API → Channel access token

invalid.providerId: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores only, at most 64, without spaces.
invalid.messagingChannelId: A channel ID has digits only.
invalid.channelSecret: A channel secret is 32 characters of 0–9 and a–f. Copy it from Basic settings again.
invalid.channelAccessToken: A channel access token is 16 to 2,048 characters without spaces. Copy it from the Messaging API tab again.
invalid.liffId: A LIFF ID is the channel ID, a dash and a code, for example 1234567890-AbCdEfGh.
invalid.liffChannelId: A channel ID has digits only.
invalid.other: Some values are not valid. Check them and save again.

webhookUrlHint: Paste it in LINE Developers Console → Messaging API → Webhook settings, then turn on Use webhook.
webhookUrlNotYet: The webhook URL shows after the LINE settings are saved the first time.
copyFailed: It could not be copied. Select the text and copy it yourself.
conflict: Another administrator saved the LINE settings while you were editing. The page now shows the latest values. Check them and make your change again if it is still needed (secrets you typed were not saved).
noAnswer: No answer came back, so it is not certain the settings were saved. Click save again (they are not saved twice) or reload the page to see what is saved.
unsaved: Save your changes first: this button uses the saved values.

refused.REQUIRED: Enter {field} the first time you save.
refused.PROVIDER_IN_USE: The provider ID cannot change while {linked, plural, one {# member is} other {# members are}} linked to LINE, because LINE gives every provider its own user IDs. Ask them to unlink first, then change it.

test.title: Test connection
test.intro: Checks one by one that LINE accepts the saved values and can deliver webhooks to BCS. It takes at most {seconds} seconds.
test.passed: Every check passed. LINE is ready.
test.failed: {count, plural, one {# check did not pass. Fix it as it says} other {# checks did not pass. Fix them as each one says}}, then test again.
test.notConfigured: Save the LINE settings first, then test.

accessToken.title: Channel access token
accessToken.tokenUnreadable: The saved access token cannot be read because the system encryption key changed. Enter the token again and save.
accessToken.unauthorized: LINE does not accept this token: it may be mistyped, expired or replaced by a newer one. In LINE Developers Console → Messaging API → Channel access token, click Issue, paste the token in the Channel access token field and save.
accessToken.forbidden: LINE does not let this token use the Messaging API. Check that it is the token of this account's Messaging API channel and that the account's plan allows the API.
accessToken.unreachable: LINE cannot be reached right now ({cause}). Wait a moment and test again.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL set in LINE
webhookUrl.ok: LINE sends webhooks to {expected} and Use webhook is on.
webhookUrl.needsAccessToken: This check runs once the access token passes.
webhookUrl.notSet: No webhook URL is set in LINE. In LINE Developers Console → Messaging API → Webhook settings, paste {expected}, click Update and turn on Use webhook.
webhookUrl.mismatch: The webhook URL in LINE is {registered} but it must be {expected}. Change it in LINE Developers Console → Messaging API → Webhook settings.
webhookUrl.inactive: The webhook URL is right but Use webhook is off. Turn it on in LINE Developers Console → Messaging API → Webhook settings.
webhookUrl.unreachable: LINE cannot be reached right now ({cause}). Wait a moment and test again.

webhookReachable.title: LINE can reach BCS
webhookReachable.ok: LINE delivered a test webhook to BCS and the signature is right.
webhookReachable.needsAccessToken: This check runs once the access token passes.
webhookReachable.couldNotConnect: LINE cannot connect to {expected}. BCS must be reachable from the internet over https and its address (APP_URL) must be right. Ask the BCS team if you are not sure.
webhookReachable.timeout: BCS did not answer LINE in time. Test again; if it still fails, tell the BCS team.
webhookReachable.signatureRefused: LINE reached BCS but the signature did not match, so the saved channel secret is not this channel's. Copy the Channel secret from LINE Developers Console → Basic settings, paste it and save.
webhookReachable.errorStatus: BCS answered LINE with HTTP {statusCode}. Check that the address (APP_URL) points to this system; if it still fails, tell the BCS team.
webhookReachable.unclassified: LINE could not test the webhook ({detail}). Test again; if it still fails, tell the BCS team.
webhookReachable.unreachable: LINE cannot be reached right now ({cause}). Wait a moment and test again.
webhookReachable.rejected: LINE refused the test (HTTP {status}) {detail} LINE accepts webhook URLs that start with https only.

liffId.title: LIFF ID
liffId.notSet: No LIFF ID yet. Copy it from LINE Developers Console → your LINE MINI App channel and save.
liffId.channelNotSet: Also enter the Channel ID of the LINE MINI App channel that issued LIFF ID {liffId}. It is used to verify who opens the LIFF pages.
liffId.channelMismatch: LIFF ID {liffId} does not belong to channel {liffChannelId}. Copy the LIFF ID and the Channel ID from the same LINE MINI App channel.
liffId.envNotSet: This BCS system has no LIFF app set up yet, so LIFF pages cannot open. Tell the BCS team: NEXT_PUBLIC_LIFF_ID and LINE_LIFF_CHANNEL_ID are missing.
liffId.envMismatch: LIFF ID {liffId} (channel {liffChannelId}) is not the LIFF app this BCS system runs, which is {envLiffId} (channel {envLiffChannelId}). Save those two values, or tell the BCS team if your organization needs a LIFF app of its own.

richMenus.title: Both rich menus
richMenus.ok: LINE has the rich menu for people who have not linked their account and the one for linked people.
richMenus.notCreated: The rich menus are not created yet. Click "Make both rich menus again" on this page.
richMenus.needsAccessToken: This check runs once the access token passes.
richMenus.missingAtLine: LINE no longer has the {missing} rich menu. Click "Make both rich menus again" on this page.
richMenus.unreachable: LINE cannot be reached right now ({cause}). Wait a moment and test again.

richMenus.title: Rich menu
richMenus.intro: The menu under the LINE chat comes in two sets: one to link an account, for people who have not linked yet, and one to work with, for linked members. This button makes both again from the system's pictures and gives every linked member the new one.
richMenus.done: Both rich menus were made again.
richMenus.relinked: {count, plural, one {# linked member got} other {# linked members got}} the new menu.
richMenus.relinkRefused: LINE refused the menu for {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}, perhaps because they blocked the account. They get it back when they unblock it.
richMenus.relinkFailed: LINE could not give the menu to {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} for now. They keep the old one; click the button again in a moment.
richMenus.defaultNotSet: LINE did not make the link-account set the default menu yet. Click the button again in a moment.
richMenus.noAnswer: No answer came back, so it is not certain the rich menus were made. Click the button again or reload the page to see their state.

errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: Save the LINE settings first, then make the rich menus.
errors.LIFF_REQUIRED: Enter the LIFF ID and save first: the menu buttons open the BCS pages in the LINE app.
errors.TOKEN_UNREADABLE: The saved access token cannot be read. Enter the token again and save first.
errors.IMAGES: The system's rich menu pictures cannot be used. Tell the BCS team.
errors.LINE: LINE refused to make the rich menus (HTTP {status}). Test the connection above, fix what fails, then try again.
errors.CONFLICT: Another administrator saved the LINE settings while the menus were made. The page now shows the latest values; click the button again.
